title: 第一卷 第9章 无面人第一卷 第10章 秦雪儿
lines: 陈玄朝着那两人看去，这两人一副张狂的模样，一眼看去，就是泼皮无赖。
其中一人来到陈玄的前方，他瞪眼看着陈玄道：“不准在她这里买菜！赶紧滚！”
陈玄神色一动，他问道：“为何不能在他这里买！”
“小子，知道这儿是哪儿吗？这儿，是青帮的地盘儿，我们是青帮的人，我们说不准在她这里买，便不准在她这里买！”一个瘦高的男子瞪着陈玄说道。
另外那人也神色不善。
陈玄心中不爽，他转身，然后开始挑选了起来！
“你特么听不懂话是吧！”另外一人暴怒！
那女人连忙道：“客官，我不卖了，您去别家买吧！”
陈玄看了她一眼，他发现她的眼神之中，带着一种无奈，痛苦和绝望。
但是此时，那个人已经抬手一把朝着陈玄的衣领抓了过来。
陈玄眼眸一眯，他刚要有所动作！
就在这个时候，一道人影冲了过来，然后他一把抓住了陈玄，陈玄只觉得一股力量传来，他整个人被拉着后退了一步。
陈玄转身看了过去，他看到自己的旁边，正站着一个人，他穿着一身夸张的白色服饰，脸上用不知道是面糊还是石灰之类的，抹成了一片的白色。
这让陈玄有些认不出来。
这个时候，这个怪人道：“两位大哥，他年纪小不懂事儿，希望你们不要和他一般见识，我这就带他走！”
听到这个声音，陈玄下意识的开口道：“哥！”
是的，眼前这人，正是陈玄的哥哥，陈岩。
那两人看着陈岩，他似乎认识陈岩一般道：“你弟弟？”
“是啊！强哥，他刚来城里，不懂规矩，希望您大人不记小人过，我改天请您吃饭！”陈岩连忙道。
那人这才瞪了一眼陈玄道：“小子，老子给你哥一点儿面子！这次饶了你，记住了，以后你在其他家买菜我不管，但是敢在这里买…哼！”
说完，他这才转身离开！
陈玄看了看那个女人，那女人脸上带着一种无奈之色。
陈岩却不想陈玄沾染太多麻烦，他拉着陈玄道：“你跟我来！”
陈玄被拉着，走到了菜市场的外围，陈岩看着陈玄说道：“看来赵凇还挺关照你的，居然是让你来采买了！”
陈玄苦笑了一声，然后他说道：“不是赵凇让我来的，我现在是二夫人的私人厨子！”
“二夫人的私人厨子？”陈岩眼睛陡然放大道：“将军府二夫人的私人厨子？”
“是啊，她喜欢我做的菜！”陈玄说道：“对了，刚才那是怎么回事儿？”
陈岩这才叮嘱着说道：“你小子，别犯轴，这京都，随便一个人的怒气砸下来，就会砸死咱们这种平头百姓，那个女人叫穆念，你也看到了，她生得漂亮，被青帮的堂主王虎看上了，但是她却死活不愿意！”
“而这个菜市，是青帮的地盘儿，于是青帮便不许人在她那里买菜，想要以此来逼迫她嫁给王虎！”陈岩说道：“总之，在京都，别招惹青帮！”
“你认识青帮的人？还有你脸上和这穿着打扮是怎么回事儿？”陈玄问道。
陈岩说道：“我在青帮当无面人，这个事情你知道就行了，回家别告诉爹娘和小妹，省得他们担心！”
“无面人？”陈玄疑惑的问道。

Chen Xuan looked at the two people. They looked arrogant. At first glance, they looked like rogues.
One of them came to the front of Chen Xuan. He glared at Chen Xuan and said, "You are not allowed to buy food from her! Get out of here!"
Chen Xuan's expression changed, and he asked: "Why can't you buy it from him?"
"Boy, do you know where this is? This is the territory of the Qinggang. We are from the Qinggang. If we are not allowed to buy from her, we are not allowed to buy from her!" A tall and thin man glared at Chen Xuan and said.
In addition, the man also looked bad.
Chen Xuan felt unhappy. He turned around and started picking!
"You can't understand the words, can you!" Another person was furious!
The woman quickly said: "Sir, I won't sell it anymore. You can buy it elsewhere!"
Chen Xuan glanced at her and found that there was helplessness, pain and despair in her eyes.
But at this time, the man had already raised his hand and grabbed Chen Xuan by the collar.
Chen Xuan narrowed his eyes, he was about to make a move!
At this moment, a figure rushed over, and then he grabbed Chen Xuan. Chen Xuan felt a force coming from him, and he was pulled back a step.
Chen Xuan turned around and looked over. He saw a person standing next to him. He was wearing an exaggerated white costume, and his face was painted white with unknown batter or lime.
This made Chen Xuan somewhat unrecognizable.
At this time, the weirdo said: "Brothers, he is young and ignorant. I hope you don't want to be like him. I will take him away right now!"
Hearing this voice, Chen Xuan subconsciously said: "Brother!"
Yes, the person in front of him is Chen Xuan's brother, Chen Yan.
The two people looked at Chen Yan, and he seemed to know Chen Yan and said, "Your brother?"
"Yes! Brother Qiang, he just came to the city and doesn't understand the rules. I hope you will not remember the villain's fault. I will treat you to dinner another day!" Chen Yan said quickly.
The man then glared at Chen Xuan and said: "Boy, I'll give your brother some face! I'll spare you this time, remember, I don't care if you buy food at other places in the future, but if you dare to buy here... hum!"
After saying that, he turned and left!
Chen Xuan looked at the woman, who had a look of helplessness on her face.
Chen Yan didn't want Chen Xuan to get into too much trouble, so he pulled Chen Xuan and said, "Follow me!"
Chen Xuan was pulled to the outskirts of the vegetable market. Chen Yan looked at Chen Xuan and said, "It seems that Zhao Song is quite concerned about you, and he actually asked you to come and buy it!"
Chen Xuan gave a bitter laugh, and then he said: "Zhao Song didn't ask me to come, I am now the second lady's personal cook!"
"The second lady's personal cook?" Chen Yan's eyes suddenly enlarged and asked: "The second lady's personal cook in the General's Mansion?"
"Yes, she likes the food I cook!" Chen Xuan said, "By the way, what happened just now?"
Chen Yan then warned: "You kid, don't offend. In Kyoto, if anyone's anger hits us, ordinary people like us will be killed. That woman's name is Mu Nian. As you can see, she is beautiful and is attracted by Wang Hu, the leader of the Qing Gang, but she refuses to do so!"
"And this vegetable market is the territory of the Qing Gang, so the Qing Gang doesn't allow people to buy vegetables from her, in order to force her to marry Wang Hu!" Chen Yan said: "In short, don't provoke the Qing Gang in Kyoto!"
"Do you know anyone from the Qinggang? And what's going on with your face and the way you're dressed?" Chen Xuan asked.
Chen Yan said: "I am a faceless man in the Qinggang. You only need to know this. Don't tell your parents and little sister when you go home, so as not to worry them!"
"Faceless man?" Chen Xuan asked doubtfully.
